newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani money rates close lower on excess funds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani money rates close lower on excess funds.

text.p: Pakistani money market rates closed sharply lower on Thursday on an inflow of 2.2 billion rupees from the maturity of an open market operation, dealers said.
The rates fell despite another open market operation on Thursday in which the central bank received a small amount, one dealer said. The amount was not immediately disclosed.
Overnight funds were initially offered at 10.00 percent but the rates slipped to 1.50 percent owing to the inflow of 2.2 billion rupees, the dealer said.
